title: ChatMessage
description: One turn of a conversation held against a library: what was asked, or what was answered, and for an answer the chunks it was grounded on. The sources are pointers with enough of the text to recognise them — never the chunk itself, which stays with the asset it came from.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The session the turn belongs to, as the system that owns the session names it. Absent on rows written before turns were scoped.

role.description: Who spoke. Two values: a person asks and the model answers, and nothing else writes a turn.

content.description: What was said. The question as typed, or the answer as generated.

sources.description: The chunks the answer was grounded on, in relevance order. Absent on a question, and empty on an answer that was grounded on nothing.

createdAt.description: When the turn was recorded. The only ordering the conversation has.
